description: Use this tool to work with documents stored in FileAssist using simple, natural language prompts. It allows users to quickly find relevant files, generate summaries, identify differences between documents, and extract key information without opening each file individually. This tool is best suited for efficiently reviewing, analyzing, and gaining insights from stored content within the FileAssist platform.
